subject: [NAME] - chat
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across your profile building R&D at socure and wanted to reach out
as we recently started working with IDV teams and [COMPANY] came up as we were
looking at teams solving similar IDV challenges.

A common theme we hear is the need to quickly understand failure modes and
tighten the feedback loop between model performance and training data -
especially in high-stakes KYC/AML workflows where small error rates matter.
Curious if this resonates with what you're seeing at [COMPANY].

For context, Encord helps IDV and FinTech teams to improve training data
quality and evaluation across document, image, and video workflows to move
faster without compromising accuracy.

Would you be open to a 20-min conversation next week to compare notes on
how you're approaching this for [YEAR]? Does *Wed 28 Jan* *1pm EST *work for
you?

subject: Human Web Agent Evals
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw the recent after_date filter added to Parallel Search API, and it
reminded of trajectory eval work we've been doing.

We've been partnering with Yutori on end-to-end web agent evals. This
covers search, tool calling, navigation, so you can measure gains vs
foundational models.

It also helps understand not just whether a task succeeded, but *why* is a
behavior is better for web search.

It's an evolving process on our side, would you or someone on your team be
open to connecting briefly?

-[SENDER]

subject: Reconnecting on Speech Labeling
text:
Hi [NAME],

We were previously in touch with [SENDER] when the team was exploring ways to
level up the speech labeling workflow.

Not sure if you're still using Gradio, but we've since been working closely
with foundation labs like Synthesia, Mirage, and Thinking Machines on
multimodal data labeling and human evaluations along with several
audio-focused teams as well.

We support audio and video ingestion, as well as preference ranking across
paired audio/video outputs.

Would you be open to a brief reconnect? I'd love to hear how the team is
thinking about this as the year gets started.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY] | Intro to Video AI team
text:

I am reaching out since we got the chance to meet with Sanat from your team
last week who shared some context into some of the initiatives you are

Could be good for us to chat / introduce ourselves and swap notes about

Would you be open to catching up virtually next week? Here is my calendar

Have a great weekend!

subject: Re: data pipeline partnerships
text:
Hi [NAME],

As a quick introduction, we previously explored a partnership between
Capella and Encord when Charles Ince was leading partnerships, focused on
supporting AI teams working with geospatial data.

Since then, we've continued working closely with geospatial organisations,
including Maxar, on SAR-driven Earth observation pipelines. The focus has
increasingly been on helping ML and radar teams unify curation, annotation
and evaluation, helping them produce better quailty data for greater model
performance.

I was wondering whether Capella's AI/ML needs have evolved since those
earlier conversations, and whether it's worth revisiting. Happy to share
what we're seeing across the space.

Open to a short chat this week?

subject: Inpatient CDI projects
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope you've been well! Ambience came to mind as we've recently kicked off a
few projects with healthcare teams building AI for pre-, in-, and
post-clinic workflows.

We keep seeing similar use cases come up - EHR extraction, conversation
diarization and transcription, preliminary diagnostic support, and
post-visit planning. The bottleneck is usually the same: getting
high-quality training data in place to iterate quickly and safely.

That's where Encord fits in. We support MedTech and GenAI teams streamline
their ML pipelines - from data ingestion and curation to labeling, HITL
review, and RLHF.

Curious if any of this overlaps with what you're building at Ambience. Open
to a quick 20 min chat to compare notes?
